usefulness.rationale: All dossier claim statements are empty; only citation quotes carry substance. From them a reader learns Gebru founded/executive-directs DAIR, formerly co-led Google's Ethical AI team, was publicly fired by Google, and has written on exploited labor behind AI and harmful EA-influenced AI ethics. That is a thin but coherent sketch matching the identity anchors. However, everything rests on a single 2023 podcast source (same underlying archive.org URL appears twice), the contested Google departure and ideas claims are flagged contested without resolution, and there is no detail on her research, publications, or DAIR's work. No overclaims can be matched because the dossier's own statements contain no verbatim text; the listed unjustified conclusions (current Google role, feed authorship, DAIR size) do not appear in the dossier.
